mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month and the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST shows a sustained increase over three months and the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 1% in a month and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is below 1% and GDPC1 growth is negative, but the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 in a month and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals consumer confidence and economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by more than 1% in a month and the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is below 2%, but the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.
